narr: A line of thunderstorms trained across parts of the tri-state area, bringing flash flooding to portions of southeast Alabama and southwest Georgia. Considerable flash flooding occurred across Houston county, Alabama where rainfall amounts near 7 inches were measured in just a few hours. In Georgia, rainfall amounts around 5 inches were observed. For the Florida panhandle, rainfall amounts were not as high, but there was one measured gust in excess of 60 mph.
ev: The 1500 block of West 3rd Ave was flooded.
Water was reported over roadways in and around Blakely.
Several roads were flooded across Calhoun county.
A drainage pond overflowed its embankment, and six to eight inches of water covered a portion of Georgia Highway 45.
GA-32 was reported flooded and closed at Graves Springs Road.

Photos from the EM showed much of Dawson Street flooded more than a foot deep in Sasser. The flooding extended from near Cranberry Drive to Hicks Road. In addition, numerous drainage culverts were full or overflowing throughout the county south of Highway 82.
Water was reported over the road at Mossy Dell Road at GA-32. The road was reported to be closed.

The intersection of West Oglethorpe and South Monroe was flooded.
